URL Slug Generator

Turn any headline into a clean, URL-safe slug with live preview.

URL Slug Generator

Clean, URL-safe slugs from any headline — live as you type.

Example: https://example.com/blog/your-slug

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste your headline.
  2. Choose the separator (- or _) and an optional max length.
  3. Watch the slug update live below.
  4. Click "Copy slug" to use it in your URL.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the slug generated?

The text is lowercased, accents are stripped ("café" → "cafe"), and anything that isn't a letter or number becomes the separator you chose.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. Everything runs in your browser; your headlines never leave your device.

Can I limit the slug length?

Yes — set a maximum length and the slug is cut cleanly at a word boundary so it never ends mid-word or with a dangling separator.
